PRODUCT OVERVIEW

Built for Efficient Handling · Crane and Cargo Platform in One

The JDV5310JSQS1 is a key model in Hubei Ouyang Jude's multipurpose range, combining a cargo platform with a knuckle-boom or straight-boom crane for independent loading and unloading across construction materials, electrical equipment, municipal projects and emergency services.

Crane options include SANY, XCMG and Changzheng, with capacities from 3T to 16T. The cargo chassis uses T700C high-strength steel side beams. The Xiangqi brand is listed in China's vehicle type-approval catalog, with factory-direct sales and after-sales support across 30+ provincial regions.

FEATURES

Key Features

Five Structural Features · Built for Lifting and Transport

01 CRANE

Established Crane Brands

Choose SANY, XCMG, Changzheng or Shimei cranes with capacities from 3 to 16 t and knuckle-boom or straight-boom designs for confined or open working spaces.

02 PLATFORM

T700C High-Strength Chassis

T700C high-strength side beams and crossmembers provide torsion and impact resistance to support both crane weight and cargo under sustained heavy loads.

03 SUPPORT

Front & Rear Hydraulic Stabilizers

Front and rear hydraulic stabilizers help keep the vehicle stable during operation, with independently extending front stabilizers for narrow working areas.

04 MULTI-USE

One Vehicle · Loading and Transport

Load and unload without separate lifting equipment. For construction materials, electrical equipment and municipal projects, the integrated design reduces labor and forklift requirements.

05 SAFETY

Dual Braking + ABS

Air brakes, KOMEE ABS, crane overload alarms and an emergency brake provide additional protection for lifting and transport。
